title: Emoji reactions (beyond favourites)
description: Misskey allows reacting to posts with any emoji, not just a binary favourite. Store reactions as (post_id, user_id, emoji) tuples. AP representation: Like activity with content field set to the emoji. Mastodon ignores the emoji and treats it as a favourite. Misskey clients display the full reaction set. fieldwork-db::reactions_db module.
close_reason: Misskey compatibility complete. reactions_db (4 functions, 3 tests), Misskey API (8 POST endpoints) in all 3 servers with emoji reaction support.
